title: PropertiesPanel has no view for GroupObject — shows empty panel
description: getView() in PropertiesPanel.tsx dispatches on obj.type for shape/instance/text/bitmap/video but has no branch for 'group' (GroupObject). Selecting a grouped object shows nothing below the header. Fix: add a GroupView component (or at minimum a placeholder that shows group dimensions and allows ungrouping). Location: packages/authoring-ui/src/PropertiesPanel.tsx around line 97.
